title: Yorkshire Cheese Puffs
description: Star chef Grant Achatz combines the crunch of a popover with the creaminess of Yorkshire pudding in these puffed breads. For maximum cheesy flavor, grated English Cheshire is added twice—stirred into the batter and then sprinkled over the top.
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups finely grated Cheshire or aged cheddar cheese
2 teaspoons chopped fresh sage, plus more for garnish
1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, plus more for garnish
Rendered beef fat or unsalted butter, for greasing
directions: In a blender, combine the milk, flour, eggs and salt and puree until smooth.
Transfer to a medium bowl and stir in 1 cup of the cheese, the 2 teaspoons of sage and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.
Set a popover or muffin pan on a baking sheet.
Spoon 1 teaspoon of fat into each of 8 popover cups or 12 muffin cups and heat in the oven for about 10 minutes.
Spoon the batter into the cups, filling them three-fourths full, and bake for about 25 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Sprinkle the puddings with the remaining 1/4 cup of cheese and bake for about 3 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Garnish with sage and pepper and serve immediately.
